java-environment.title: Beginning Java programming with Hello World Example | GeeksforGeeks
java-environment.focus: Follow a complete Hello World program, identify the main method, then compile and run your own first message.

java-environment.title: Difference between JVM, JRE & JDK
java-environment.focus: Watch how the JDK, JRE, and JVM fit together before setting up and running your first Java program.

input-output.title: How to Take Input From User in Java?
input-output.focus: Compare Scanner and BufferedReader, read text and numeric values, then print only the result your exercise asks for.

variables.title: Variables and Primitive DataTypes
variables.focus: Declare and initialize variables, choose an appropriate primitive type, and practice assigning a new value and converting between types.

operators.title: #2.5 Java Tutorial | Arithmetic Operators in Java — Telusko
operators.focus: Predict arithmetic, integer division, remainder, and increment results before running each expression.

operators.title: #11 Logical Operators in Java — Telusko
operators.focus: Combine comparison results with logical operators. Write a small truth table, then test each expression in Java.

conditions.title: DSA in Java: If Else — Java in One Shot
conditions.focus: Code along with the even-or-odd and greatest-of-three examples. Pause before each branch and predict which result will print.

conditions.title: Decision Making in Java (if, if-else, switch, break, continue, jump)
conditions.focus: Trace which branch executes for each condition and how switch, break, and continue change control flow.

loops.title: DSA in Java: Loops — Java in One Shot
loops.focus: Start at 02:44 for loop basics and trace the dry run at 10:14. Continue to while at 2:24:31 and do-while at 2:32:52, then compare their stopping rules.

methods.title: DSA in Java: Methods — Java in One Shot
methods.focus: Write and call methods with parameters and return values. Rebuild one repeated piece of code as a reusable method.

arrays.title: DSA in Java: Arrays — Java in One Shot
arrays.focus: Code along with array declaration, indexing, traversal, and updates. Pause each problem before the solution and try it yourself.

arrays.title: Arrays Class in Java
arrays.focus: Watch how Java's Arrays utility methods simplify common array operations.

strings.title: DSA in Java: Strings — Java in One Shot
strings.focus: Practice character access, comparison, substring, and string manipulation. Predict each result before running the example.

stringbuilder.title: String Builder | Java Placement Course Lecture 13 — Apna College
stringbuilder.focus: Practice changing mutable text with StringBuilder. Build a short message, edit its characters, and compare it with an immutable String.

oop.title: DSA in Java: Object Oriented Programming
oop.focus: Follow the Java examples, then build a small class that demonstrates encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, and abstraction.

oop.title: Four Main Object Oriented Programming Concepts of Java
oop.focus: Connect encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, and abstraction to a small Java class of your own.

exception-handling.title: Java Exceptions and Exception Handling — GeeksforGeeks
exception-handling.focus: Follow the workshop on Java exceptions. Trigger a small runtime error, add a handler, and trace how program execution changes.

exception-handling.title: Overview of Exception Handling In Java
exception-handling.focus: Trace the execution path through try, catch, finally, and thrown exceptions.

collections-framework.title: Java Collections Framework
collections-framework.focus: Compare List, Set, Map, and Queue so you can choose a collection from its behavior.

collections-framework.title: Java Collection Framework — Part 2: Advanced Concepts and Examples
collections-framework.focus: After the overview, compare List, Set, and Map implementations and the HashMap versus TreeMap examples.

arraylist.title: ArrayList in Java
arraylist.focus: Follow how a resizable list is created, updated, accessed, and traversed.

linkedlist-api.title: LinkedList in Java
linkedlist-api.focus: Watch how Java's LinkedList class is created and manipulated through its collection methods.

hashmap.title: DSA in Java: HashMap 01 — Java in One Shot
hashmap.focus: Build a map with put, get, remove, and containsKey, then follow the hashing and collision examples.

hashmap.title: HashMap with Java
hashmap.focus: Track each key-value pair as entries are inserted, retrieved, updated, and removed.

hashset.title: Video - HashSet in Java
hashset.focus: Observe how set operations handle duplicate values and membership checks.

deque-api.title: ArrayDeque in Java | Internal Working of ArrayDeque in Java — KK JavaTutorials
deque-api.focus: Follow the ArrayDeque demo, then write a small stack using push, peek, and pop. Trace which item leaves first.

queue-api.title: Learn Queue data structures in 10 minutes — Bro Code
queue-api.focus: Follow the Java FIFO queue example with offer and poll. Add three arrivals and predict the order in which they are processed.

priorityqueue.title: Learn Priority Queue data structures in 5 minutes — Bro Code
priorityqueue.focus: Practice Java PriorityQueue ordering. Insert unsorted numbers, then poll repeatedly to observe the smallest waiting value come out first.

comparator.title: Arrays.sort() in Java with examples | Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA)
comparator.focus: Focus on the custom Comparator example and how its comparison determines the sort order.

collections.title: Lecture-5 Mastering Sorting Algorithms with Java: From Collections.sort to Custom Comparators
collections.focus: Follow Collections.sort with Java lists. Print a list before and after sorting to understand the order and the data the utility changes.

generics.title: Generics in Java
generics.focus: Watch how type parameters let reusable Java code work with specific types safely.

recursion-basics.title: DSA in Java: Recursion Part 1 — Java in One Shot
recursion-basics.focus: Trace the base case and call stack in factorial and Fibonacci. Draw a small call tree before running each example.

file-handling.title: Java File Input/Output - It's Way Easier Than You Think — Coding with John
file-handling.focus: Practice reading and writing a text file with buffered readers and writers. Then try Java’s try-with-resources syntax to close resources after success or failure.

complexity.title: Calculating Time Complexity
complexity.focus: Count how loop iterations grow with input size and connect that growth to Big O notation.

multithreading.title: Introduction to Multithreading (JAVA)
multithreading.focus: Watch how concurrent threads are introduced and distinguish a thread's work from the main program flow.

java8-features.title: Java 8 Predicate with Examples
java8-features.focus: Focus on functional interfaces, lambda expressions, and predicates that return a boolean.

java8-features.title: Stream in Java
java8-features.focus: Watch how stream operations express data processing as a pipeline.

final-review.title: Number Guessing Game in Java Tutorial (Beginning to End) — Coding with John
final-review.focus: Combine input, variables, comparisons, and loops in a complete small program. Rebuild it yourself, test low, high, and correct guesses, then add invalid-input handling.
